notes.title: Lumpy v1.2.0 - Themes and Menus
notes.content:
The first major update for Lumpy is here! Version 1.2.0 revamps the pause menu with more features and more complete information, and adds an all-new feature, planet themes!

[h1]Themes[/h1]
Each time you start a new game, a random theme will be selected for your planet. This can change the look of the orbiters surrounding your planet and the vegetation on it once it exists, meaning you can build a different looking planet each time!

[h1]Menus[/h1]
The pause menu has been updated in a few ways to make it much more useful.
[list]
[*][b]Credits[/b] - The credits section has been expanded upon to be much more descriptive and accurate, as it did not include the whole team previously.
[*][b]Settings[/b] - There is now a separate settings menu, which contains separate volume sliders for music and sound effects. We also found a second song created by one of our wonderful team musicians, which can be chosen through the audio settings.
[*][b]Fonts[/b] - The fonts in all menus have been updated to be more consistent. 
[/list]

[h1]The Lumpy Bop[/h1]
Make sure to check out the new song on the soundtrack! That's my personal favorite part of this update. You can also find the new track here: [url=https://youtu.be/oq5VZM2z1UM]https://youtu.be/oq5VZM2z1UM[/url]
